how: Not run. The mcp_2026_07_28 feature is UnderDevelopment and off by default (codex-rs/features/src/lib.rs). With it on, a stdio server opts in with CODEX_MCP_PROTOCOL_VERSION=2026-07-28 and the client uses ClientLifecycleMode::Auto: a server/discover probe at 2026-07-28, then initialize at 2025-06-18 if the reply is not a DiscoverResult (local_stdio_transport.rs, DiscoveryOutcome::RetryLegacy). Only methods and versions are taken from source; the other fields are illustrative.
